description: This file defines the ExtNode class, which represents a node in a tree view structure for a web application. It includes properties and methods for setting node attributes, adding child nodes, and retrieving the node's hierarchical definition, primarily used for constructing dynamic tree interfaces.

classes.name: ExtNode
classes.description: A class that models a node in a tree structure used in the application's UI, supporting properties, child nodes, and data export for rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ExtNode with the provided id, label, and optional expanded state. Sets core properties and a unique identifier.

methods.name: set_property
methods.description: Sets a property or parameter for the node, with conditional handling based on whether it's a main property or a parameter.

methods.name: add_node
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node's children collection.

methods.name: get_definition
methods.description: Returns an array representing the node's data structure, including properties, parameters, children, and metadata useful for rendering.
